metadata.name: Remind me
metadata.description: Use “Remind me” in Recued. Set a one-time reminder: Recued tells you at that time, once, on every channel you set up. Work out the time from the current date and time in your context, on the user's clock. Pass it with its offset, and tell the user the time the answer gives.
metadata.author: recued-core

reminder_text.label: Reminder text
reminder_text.help: What the reminder says when it rings, in the user's words.

remind_at.label: Remind at
remind_at.help: When the reminder should ring, as an absolute ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time WITH a timezone offset (e.g. 2026-07-04T15:00:00-07:00 or 2026-07-04T22:00:00Z). Resolve the user's requested time against the current date/time in your context, in the user's timezone — do NOT assume UTC; if the timezone is unknown, ask before guessing. An offset-less value is rejected, and so is a time that has passed.
